item.title: Why Dowry Still Dictating Women’s Fate?
item.description: Dowry is still persisting in society in one form or another. This deeply entrenched social practice continues deepen household poverty and cause violence against women. item.title: COP17 Celebrates Indigenous Leaders Amid Demand for Greater Inclusion in Biodiversity Decisions

item.title: Afghanistan opium production jumps fivefold as farmers find ways round Taliban ban
item.description: Opium production in Afghanistan has risen fivefold in a year. According to a UN survey released on Thursday, it’s the first significant increase since the Taliban banned poppy cultivation in 2022.

item.title: Security Council LIVE: Can new technology keep the world’s sea lanes safe?
item.description: Cheap drones, autonomous vessels and cyberattacks are changing the threats to the world’s shipping lanes – and the tools to counter them. At an open debate on Thursday, the Security Council is weighing how emerging technologies could both endanger and protect seafarers, global trade and food and energy supplies.

item.title: Myanmar’s illicit economy fuels escalating violence, with civilians bearing the brunt
item.description: Myanmar’s human rights situation is “catastrophic”, the UN independent expert on the country warned at a press briefing Thursday, as the war spirals with no end in sight.

item.title: AI is changing the way we think. The question is whether we’ll notice in time
item.description: Artificial intelligence promises to make life easier. With a few keystrokes, it can write emails, summarize reports, generate ideas and answer complex questions in seconds. For many people, it feels like a technological leap on par with the arrival of the internet itself.

item.title: World News in Brief: 5 children killed in Sudan, Haiti hunger emergency, Yemen war update
item.description: At least five children were killed and two others injured in a drone attack on a market in Nyala, in Sudan’s South Darfur state, on Monday, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) said on Thursday.

item.title: Russia drone strike on Ukrainian railway station kills 13
item.description: The UN’s top humanitarian official in Ukraine on Thursday condemned a Russian drone attack on the city of Dnipro that killed at least 13 civilians and injured 10 others at its main railway station.

item.title: Nature is making a comeback – now restoration funding must quadruple
item.description: From salmon spawning grounds in Canada to coral reefs in Indonesia, ecosystems around the world are being restored at an unprecedented rate.
